gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming what the axes of a diggs:RelativeLocation's relativePosition2D/3D mean, for the value of frameConvention. PROVISIONAL - built from documented practice (project-baseline station/offset/elevation referencing; trench and test-pit face logging grids) rather than a single citable naming standard, and platform_relative is an inference with no located precedent found; flagged for SME review the same way R10's and VERT1's provisional dictionaries are.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Relative-Location Frame Convention Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Position along a project baseline (station/chainage), perpendicular offset from it (conventionally signed left/right facing increasing station), and elevation. Standard practice for locating borings, embankments and other features against a roadway or corridor alignment.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Station, offset, elevation

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Horizontal distance along an exposed trench or test-pit face from a designated origin, and vertical distance from a datum line strung on the face - standard practice for logging trench walls and test-pit faces.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Trench or test-pit face grid

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Two horizontal ordinates from a site-local origin, with elevation for the 3-dimensional form - a generic local grid with no project-baseline or face-logging structure.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Local site grid

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Plan position plus height above a platform or embankment base, such as a load transfer platform. Inferred to fit this schema's own LTP/lift structure; no independent practice citation was found - treat as the most provisional of these four entries.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Platform-relative
